bash -lc 'python3 - <<"PY"
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

# Helper to draw a mock UI screenshot
def draw_screenshot(out_path, during=True, fraction=0.6):
    w, h = 1280, 720
    img = Image.new("RGB", (w, h), color=(250,250,250))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    # Title
    font = ImageFont.load_default()
    text = "Swipe to seek: During gesture" if during else "Swipe to seek: Post-gesture"
    draw.text((40,40), text, font=font, fill=(0,0,0))
    if during:
        # Bottom HUD bar
        hud_h = 100
        hud_y = h - hud_h
        draw.rectangle([0, hud_y, w, h], fill=(0,0,0,60))
        # Label: target / duration
        label = "01:23 / 05:00"
        draw.text((40, hud_y+14), label, font=font, fill=(255,255,255))
        # Progress track
        track_y = hud_y + 40
        track_height = 12
        track_margin = 40
        draw.rectangle([track_margin, track_y, w - track_margin, track_y + track_height], fill=(100,100,100))
        # Progress fill
        fill_w = (w - 2*track_margin) * fraction
        draw.rectangle([track_margin, track_y, track_margin + fill_w, track_y + track_height], fill=(0,200,0))
        # Target marker
        marker_x = track_margin + fill_w
        draw.line([(marker_x, track_y-2), (marker_x, track_y + track_height + 2)], fill=(255,255,255), width=2)
    img.save(out_path)

# Generate images
draw_screenshot("/workspace/.tmp/during_swipe_linux.png", during=True, fraction=0.65)
draw_screenshot("/workspace/.tmp/post_swipe_linux.png", during=False)
print("OK")

PY'
